title: AdHocQueryExecutionResponse
description: Result of an ad-hoc query execution. When status is `ready`, column metadata plus positionally-aligned result rows are included; when `deferred`/`running`, status, deferred_result_key, and infinity_session are set (poll GetAdHocQueryExecution).

status.description: Outcome discriminator. `ready`: the result set is present. `deferred`: the run was queued — poll GetAdHocQueryExecution with deferred_result_key. `running`: (fetch) still executing — poll again with the same key.

deferred_result_key.description: Key to fetch the completed result via GetAdHocQueryExecution. Present when status is `deferred` or `running`; null once `ready`.

infinity_session.description: Load-balancer session-affinity cookie value. Returned alongside a `deferred`/`running` status; pass it back (with deferred_result_key) on GetAdHocQueryExecution and DeleteAdHocQueryExecution via the infinity_session query parameter so the poll/cancel reach the same server session that holds the result. Null once `ready`.

fields.description: Output column metadata in execution order. The implicit QUERYRECID primary-key column appears unless suppress_primary_key_field was set.

rows.description: Result rows. Each row's values array is positionally aligned with fields. Empty when do_return_data was false.

row_count.description: Total row count when reported. Null when bypass_record_count was set or the query view doesn't supply one.

had_more_results.description: True when the result set was truncated. Paginate via start/limit to fetch the remainder.

sql.description: The generated T-SQL. Populated when do_return_data was false (SQL-only) or include_security_sql was true; otherwise null.

record_type_id.description: The record type associated with the executed query. Null when not reported.

query_was_cancelled.description: True when the query was cancelled before completion. Null when not reported.

name.description: Column name as it appears in result rows.

data_type.description: Data type of the column (String, Integer, Date, Guid, etc.).

is_primary_key.description: True for the synthetic QUERYRECID primary-key column.

values.description: Cell values, one per output field, in the same order as fields. An individual entry is null when the underlying cell was null.

AdHocQueryRunResponseRow.description: A single result row. Values are positionally aligned with the response fields.
